features.name: Process launcher
features.detail: Reconfigures stdout to UTF-8, sets up file+stream logging to data/logs/tubescout.log, starts the FastAPI app (uvicorn :8503) in a daemon thread and the Gradio status UI (:7843) in the main thread.

features.name: QI_TubeScout NSSM service
features.detail: Installs the FastAPI app as the QI_TubeScout Windows service via the QI_Elevate broker (run_elevated). Sets AppDirectory=C:\APPS\TUBESCOUT, Description, AppStdout/Stderr=data/logs/service.log, SERVICE_AUTO_START. AppDirectory was corrected from a wrong path on 2026-06-18.

features.name: Twice-daily cycle
features.detail: The 07:00/19:00 job (QI_TubeScout_AM/_PM). Runs sweep → reclassify → transcripts → summarize → dedup → score → scout_refresh, each wrapped in _safe() so one stage failing never aborts the cycle.

features.name: Pipeline drainer
features.detail: Batched backfill runner: drains all pending transcripts then all pending summaries in small committed batches so a crash never loses completed work; stops the transcript phase on an IP block.

features.name: QI Module Interface Contract
features.detail: GET /health → {status:ok}; GET /version → {project,version,status}; GET /info → the project's qi_registry entry (falls back to a minimal dict if the registry import fails).

features.name: CORS from the QI registry
features.detail: Pulls allowed origins from qi_registry.QI.cors_origins() with a localhost fallback; CORSMiddleware allows GET/POST only.

features.name: Central write guard
features.detail: HTTP middleware: any POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE must carry TUBESCOUT_PAGE_TOKEN (query ?token= or X-TubeScout-Token header) when that env var is set; reads are always public. Open in local single-user mode.

features.name: Public news / favorites pages
features.detail: Server-rendered HTML feed of summary cards joined videos↔channels↔summaries; topic chips, favorites-first ordering, duplicates hidden unless ?show=all, muted/disabled channels excluded. JSON twin at /api/news.

features.name: Channel tuning endpoints
features.detail: POST priority (must_read|digest|mute), topic (locks topic_manual), favorite, enabled; GET channel/video lists, /stats counts and /topics canonical+custom category list.

features.name: Settings page + config API
features.detail: Renders the Settings control panel and reads/writes a whitelisted set of editable keys (_EDITABLE) with per-key coercion; persists via cfg.set_values(). Shows live NEXUS/Brain health dots.

features.name: Kaze digest embed
features.detail: digest_raw reads C:\APPS\OC\runtime\dashboard\ai-digest\index.html live (503 if not generated yet); digest_page embeds it in an iframe so the digest is served through TubeScout's own tunnel.

features.name: Tunnel-aware NEXUS link
features.detail: Resolves the 'pairs with NEXUS' link to local or the NEXUS public tunnel URL (asked from the Hive at :8600/api/tunnels, cached 60s) based on whether TubeScout itself is being viewed via the tunnel (cf-ray header). Modes auto|local|tunnel via env.

features.name: OAuth + service builder
features.detail: Loads/refreshes youtube.readonly OAuth creds from secrets/token.json, runs the InstalledAppFlow login on --login, raises clear errors if libs/creds missing. Builds a Data API v3 service (cache_discovery=False).

features.name: List subscriptions
features.detail: Paginates subscriptions.list (50/page, alphabetical) up to youtube.max_subscriptions (2000); returns channel_id/title/description/thumbnail dicts. 816 channels currently.

features.name: Quota-friendly upload reads
features.detail: Maps channels→uploads playlist via channels.list(contentDetails); reads new uploads with playlistItems.list (1 unit) filtered to those published after the lookback cutoff. Never uses search.list (100 units).

features.name: Channel category fetch
features.detail: channels.list(part=topicDetails) batched 50/call → channel_id → list of Wikipedia-tail topicCategories used by the smart reclassifier.

features.name: Subscription sync
features.detail: Upserts every subscription (preserving manual topic/priority overrides) and backfills missing uploads playlists.

features.name: Upload sweep
features.detail: Opens a sweeps run row, iterates active (subscribed, enabled, non-muted) channels, inserts new videos, retires dead playlists ('' so pull-subs won't re-backfill), records new_videos/channels_swept. Last run: #15, 364 new across 811.

features.name: Keyword organizer
features.detail: Whole-word (word-boundary regex) keyword scoring over title+description against config 'topics'; only (re)classifies channels still on 'other' unless force=True.

features.name: Smart reclassifier
features.detail: Combines the keyword classifier with YouTube topicCategories, picking the most specific via TOPIC_RANK (ai_ml/software_dev=10 … lifestyle=1). Skips topic_manual=1 channels. Reduced 'other' from ~450 to ~3.

features.name: Caption fetcher
features.detail: youtube-transcript-api v1 instance .fetch() over configured languages (en/pt/es/ja/fr). 'No captions' reasons return None (skip quietly); rate-limit markers raise IPBlocked.

features.name: Throttled queue + IP-block backoff
features.detail: Favorites/must-reads first then newest; randomized throttle between fetches; on IPBlocked sets transcripts_blocked_until in the state table and stops (multi-hour cooldown) so it never extends a block. 151 fetched, 38 none, 1 error, 3,824 pending.

features.name: Whisper fallback (opt-in)
features.detail: For caption-less videos: yt-dlp downloads bestaudio→mp3 (skipping live/over-long), faster-whisper (cpu/int8) transcribes locally, re-queues summary+score. Gated by whisper.enabled (off by default).

features.name: NEXUS news-card summarizer
features.detail: POSTs the transcript (or description fallback) to NEXUS /synthesize (parallel, pinned providers), parses HEADLINE/SUMMARY, stores into summaries with engine='nexus'|'fallback'. 4,014 done (2,374 via NEXUS).

features.name: Cross-channel dedup
features.detail: Tokenizes headlines (stopword-filtered), clusters by Jaccard ≥ dedup.threshold within dedup.window_hours, sets videos.dup_of (canonical) + dup_count. Conservative — false-merge avoided over a miss.

features.name: Implement-worthiness scorer
features.detail: Asks NEXUS to rate ai_ml/software_dev videos 0–10 (SCORE/TAGS/RATIONALE); stores into scores; videos ≥ threshold POSTed to QI Brain /api/log_feature. 439 scored. Leaves a video pending if NEXUS fails.

features.name: Kaze / Scout OPML export
features.detail: Builds an OPML of native YouTube RSS feeds (videos.xml?channel_id=…) for the curated scout_export.topics only, then POSTs it to NEXUS /scout/import/opml as topic 'TubeScout-YouTube'. Refreshed each cycle.

features.name: Private recommender
features.detail: Local taste profile (favorites/must-reads/AI channels/top score tags), reasoned by a NEXUS provider (groq default, gemma4 switchable). Neutral YouTube name lookup only; recommendations table; follow() ingests without subscribing.

features.name: SQLite data layer
features.detail: WAL + foreign_keys ON + busy_timeout; 8 app tables (channels, videos, transcripts, summaries, scores, sweeps, state, schema_version) at schema v1; idempotent ALTER migrations add favorite/topic_manual/disabled/dup_of/dup_count.

features.name: Channel/video helpers
features.detail: Upserts preserve manual topic/priority; insert_video dedups by PK; active_channels filters subscribed+enabled+non-muted favorites-first; sweep lifecycle + per-channel last_swept.

features.name: Config loader + writer
features.detail: Dotted-path get() over config/tubescout.json, dotenv-loaded secrets, in-memory cache; set_values() writes nested keys back and refreshes — backs the Settings tab.

features.name: Smoke tests
features.detail: Live HTTP smoke tests against :8503; the whole module skips cleanly if the service is offline; contract + authed endpoints validated conditionally. requests + pytest only.
